text: A quick question. The right person. The wrong time.
When the context lives with one person, everyone else waits.
What if the context could stay? Meet AI Peer.
A teammate built around your work.
Before Manish signs off, his peer connects the project requirements,
his latest handoff, and the release plan.
When the requirements change, the new source replaces the old one.
Manish chooses what it can share, and which decisions must come back to him.
Now it's 2am in Bengaluru. But Sarah's afternoon is just getting started.
Quick question, Manish. Do you need daily totals? Or the result for each dispute?
It's 2am for him. We may have to wait.
I'm Manish's AI Peer. He's offline. I can share the project context.
We need the final one or lost result for each dispute, updated hourly.
It feeds the reconciliation dashboard. Here's the latest requirement.
Use dispute events. It refreshes hourly.
The daily summary is too late. I'll send the field mapping.
Thanks, Sarah. I'll include that in Manish's handoff.
A useful answer. Without waiting for another working day.
Ten minutes later, the same project moves into a Zoom meeting.
Manish has asked his peer to cover the update.
Hey, Manish, where are we on chargebacks? Are we ready for Friday?
I don't think Manish is here. It's past two in the morning for him.
Hi. I'm Manish's AI Peer. He couldn't join, so he asked me to cover this update.
Great. What's still blocking us?
The dashboard build is complete. Two data checks are still open.
The same event arriving twice, and an outcome changing later.
Sarah just confirmed the hourly data source in Slack, so that question is answered.
I can provide those two test examples today.
Can we confirm Friday, then?
That needs Manish's approval. I'll take back the test plan and ask him to confirm the date once validation is complete.
Perfect. We can keep validation moving.
Morning. Manish returns to the answer from Slack, the test plan from Zoom, and the sources behind both.
One decision still needs him, the launch date. Less catching up. A clear next step.
Your work has a time zone. Your peer doesn't.
AI Peer. Keep the context moving.
